com.sun.tools.sjavac

类 BuildState

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.sjavac.BuildState

  • public class BuildState
extends Object
    The build state class captures the source code and generated artifacts from a build. There are usually two build states, the previous one (prev), loaded from the javac_state file, and the current one (now).

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.
